critical_code_review_comments: _actas_unicas_por_anfora still depends on callers projecting id_anfora. It works now, but a missing-key assert or an aggregation $group would prevent regressions.

_calcular_resultado_universitario does not filter id_anfora $exists, unlike _consolidado_publico. Actas without an ánfora are counted without dedup. There is no impact on current data because public == private.
Dedup tie-break relies only on actualizado_en desc. Consider adding a secondary sort key (id) for determinism.
server.py is about 3050 lines and should be split into routers.
